title: re:publica 2012 - Eben Moglen - Freedom of Thought Requires Free Media
summary: Eben Moglen's re:publica 2012 talk argues that media which spy on and data-mine the public threaten freedom of thought, and that free technology and free culture are needed to protect it.
why: HN users recommend Moglen as a brilliant speaker and a top introduction to free software philosophy, and cite this talk in privacy and crypto-wars discussions.

quote.text: none seems to beat those from Stallman's lawyer, Eben Moglen.
